notes: Kokoa is a VRChat-oriented dress-up rig exported to VRM 0.x with NO blendShape preset groups. @pixiv/three-vrm therefore exposes no standard VRM expressions: emotions (happy/sad/angry/relaxed/surprised) and viseme lip-sync are all unavailable. The model only carries raw 'vrc.v_*' viseme morph targets and 'vrc.blink_*' morphs, which are not wired to VRM expressions. surprisedSynthesis.ts no-ops on this model (no usable morphs). Treat Kokoa as visual-only until an emotion/viseme morph set is authored.

lip_sync.notes: No VRM expression-backed visemes. Standard lip-sync is inactive on this model.
